plugins.description: The Flow AI-DLC methodology as a Claude Code surface: the /flow-* commands, the delivery phase agents (Scope -> Shape -> Build -> Ship), a greenfield product-definition Discover phase (/flow-discover), and the governance hooks. Pairs with the `flow` CLI — run `flow init` in your repo to scaffold the .flow/ instance these commands and hooks operate on.
